summary: Students in multiple French cities have staged nationwide protests and school actions—including blockades, fires and occupations—that have forced hundreds of high schools to close. Demonstrations are aimed at poor school conditions and underfunding; clashes with riot police have occurred and prompted government attention, including a crisis meeting called by the prime minister.

summary: France’s prison system is at a new high for overcrowding: on September 1 there were 90,020 people incarcerated, the largest recorded prison population in the country according to the published reports.

summary: Brazil’s presidential contest has come down to a close rematch between former president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and incumbent Jair Bolsonaro, with both candidates neck-and-neck as voters decide between Lula’s reformist agenda and Bolsonaro’s conservative platform amid persistent allegations of corruption and a polarized political climate.

summary: Lithuania temporarily closed airspace at Vilnius Airport for about an hour after authorities detected a possible unidentified drone reportedly coming from Belarus; the incident prompted NATO to deploy aircraft to the area while the situation was investigated and flights were disrupted during the alert.

headline: South Korea demands public apology from Ukraine over POW transfer or warns of action

members.title: Seoul warns 'further action' if Ukraine does not apologise over prisoner-of-war row
South Korea warns of 'further measures' if Ukraine refuses public apology over POW transfer disclosure

summary: South Korea has told Ukraine it must publicly apologise for disclosing the transfer of a South Korean national held as a prisoner of war; Seoul said it would consider further measures if Ukraine refuses to issue the apology. Both articles state the dispute concerns the disclosure of the transfer and that South Korea has warned of additional steps should Ukraine not comply.

headline: Western Europe experienced its hottest summer on record in 2026

members.title: L’été 2026 devient le plus chaud jamais enregistré en Europe occidentale, sans provoquer de sursaut politique
L'été 2026 est le plus chaud jamais enregistré en Europe de l'Ouest, selon l'institut Copernicus
Europa occidental registra el verano más cálido de su historia

summary: European monitoring agencies recorded that the summer of 2026 was the warmest ever observed in Western Europe; multiple news outlets report this regional temperature record based on Copernicus and other observations, and note that the heat did not trigger an immediate political shift.

headline: High school blockades draw public attention and political debate

members.title: Blocage des lycées : pour LFI, un appui au mouvement à double tranchant
Blocus des lycées : LFI tente d’ajuster son discours face aux débordements
Blocus des lycées : LFI, les élèves et les professeurs, la bataille du récit
Blocus des lycées : Matignon pointe du doigt "LFI et ses proxys de l'ultragauche"

summary: Across the articles, high school students have organized blockades of lycées, prompting involvement from teachers and sparking political controversy. La France Insoumise (LFI) is publicly linked to the movement and is adjusting its messaging amid concerns about excesses; government officials have criticized LFI and allies for their role. Media coverage highlights a struggle over the narrative surrounding the protests, with authorities and school communities reacting to the disruptions.

summary: French investigative outlet Mediapart has released a set of digital documents and screenshots it says show past antisemitic messages attributed to politician Jordan Bardella; Mediapart presented these materials as evidence while Bardella continues to deny the allegations.

Espagne. Crise du logement : les députés rejettent les textes du gouvernement de Pedro Sánchez

summary: Spain’s lower chamber voted down two housing measures proposed by Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez’s government in response to a social movement over the housing crisis. The defeats represent a political setback for Sánchez and leave the executive without the contested tools it had sought to address rising public discontent about housing.
